faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Research Fellow positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Fellow positions at IIT Roorkee is 31st August 2026. Ensure all your details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Research Fellow position at the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a four-year Bachelor’s degree or a two-year Master’s degree with GATE qualification, or a degree from an IIT with a CGPA of 8.0 or above. Proficiency in Machine Learning is mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Research Fellow positions at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Research Fellow position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 60,000, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Fellow positions at IIT Roorkee will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What are the preferred skills for the Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: While Machine Learning proficiency is required, candidates with additional skills in Deep Learning, GenAI, and Mathematical Optimization are preferred for this role.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contract-based job. The position of Research Fellow is offered on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article. Please ensure you check all details before applying.
